build_GumbelSoftmaxWrapper: build a GumbelSoftmaxWrapper around an agent module to sample discrete symbols via Gumbel-Softmax relaxation
build_SymbolGameGS: build a SymbolGameGS sender-receiver game with a custom loss function for single-symbol communication
build_RnnSenderGS: build an RnnSenderGS agent that generates variable-length symbol sequences using an RNN cell and Gumbel-Softmax
build_SenderReceiverRnnGS: build a SenderReceiverRnnGS game for variable-length sender-receiver communication with end-of-sequence handling
build_RelaxedEmbedding: build a RelaxedEmbedding layer that accepts both integer indices and one-hot float vectors as input
